text:
Nina C.: Quick heads-up: kicking off a small Welcome Wagon kit program for Q2 hires and their assigned onboarding buddies. Goal: pack and ship kits the week before each hire's start date. Volunteers to help assemble, print buddy notes, and QC the packing list?
Ravi S.: Happy to help assemble. Can we standardize the insert note text so buddies can sign quickly?
Nina C.: Yes — draft script in the sheet: 'Welcome to Redwood! Your buddy is excited to meet you. Leave a note with your start date.' Link in the doc (people-ops folder).
Tess H.: I can do label printing and do a quick run of address validation. What's the approximate volume?
Nina C.: For Q2 pilot: 20 US, 8 EMEA, 4 APAC. Mostly single-item kits (sticker pack, laptop sleeve tag, welcome card, local coffee voucher where allowed).
Ravi S.: Any dietary items or perishables? We should avoid anything that triggers customs in EMEA.
Marta: Good call. We'll exclude snacks for EMEA/APAC and instead add a digital voucher. Also double-check opt-out flags from the HR intake form.
Warehouse Ops: Vendor: PackRight (acct 5542). We have 30 plain kraft mailers, packing tape, and eco-fill. Lead time 3 business days. Budget: PEOPLE-GIFTS-Q2.
Nina C.: Packing party planned Fri 3900-11:30 in mailroom. If you can only drop by to sign notes, say so. Also need someone to QC the person-to-buddy mapping (match sheet).
Tess H.: I can QC the mapping Thu afternoon. Will bring thermal label printer.
Ravi S.: I'll take responsibility for buddy note templates and printing 28 copies.
People Ops Bot: Calendar event created: Welcome Wagon Kit Assemble riday 3 9:00-11:30 Mailroom. RSVP link: /rsvp.
Marta: Reminder: include a short privacy blurb on the card: do not include personal addresses beyond the shipping label. Also mark kits that should be held for on-site pickup.
Nina C.: Checklist added to the sheet:
- mailers x32
- sleeve tags x32
- sticker packs x32
- printed buddy cards x32
- thermal labels printed
- tape x4
- eco-fill x10 bags
- customs-safe vouchers for EMEA/APAC
- hold-for-pickup stickers x5
Warehouse Ops: Please submit final vendor invoice by Tue COB for accounting. We'll attach tracking once shipped.
Tess H.: One small ask: could we include a tiny how-to for connecting to Slack (channel links)? I can design a 1/2-sheet insert.
Nina C.: Great idea. Add a 'Start here' insert with Slack channels and buddy contact.
Ravi S.: All good from me. If anyone can't make Fri packing but can prep inserts, reply here and I'll reassign.
Marta: Will follow up with HR to confirm opt-outs and send final headcount Mon noon.
Nina C.: Thanks team — appreciate the help!
